verdict.rationale: vLLM publishes extensive developer docs, so this axis applies. However, the probe returned HTTP 404 for docs.vllm.ai/llms.txt, and no evidence shows any other agent-oriented docs. The runtime OpenAPI schema and Swagger UI are a different capability (machine-readable API spec), not agent-oriented documentation, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
